proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: S↔L: ref is sibling-only. `pn_averaging_unique` closes by `rw [hN.norm q, hN'.norm q]` (lean:211-212), from the pointwise class field `norm : ∀ q : R, σ_pn q = z q` (lean:80) alone. That is a tautology over the hypothesised value; `BarInvariant` and `ColorFlavorCompatible` (lean:206, 208) are unused extra hypotheses. Hypothesis (c) "σ_pn = z" (md:7) pins σ to z, so the "uniqueness" is the hypothesis. Under convention D the hypotheses are jointly unsatisfiable: z(q) − z(q⁻¹) = (q−1)(q+1)/q ≠ 0 (sympy), so (a) and (c) cannot both hold and the theorem is vacuous for the z the block uses. Neither production candidate z − h/2 nor the weighted form (md:11) satisfies (c). The Lean docstrings are stale: "z = 1/(q^{1/2} + q^{-1/2})" (lean:74, excised convention C) and "Both candidates satisfy bar-invariance" (lean:25), which the md retracts (md:13). Its CODATA comparison, "reproduces Δm_{n−p} to ≈ 0.14 % of CODATA" (lean:20-21), is empirical provenance in the carrier file. The md's "functionals on H_{3A}(R,q)" and "equal block-wise" become bare functions R → R. No proof block.
